en.hubeali: H 14523 – And by this chain, from Abaan, from Uqba Bin Basheer Al-Asady, from Al-Kumeyt Bin Zayd Al-asady who said:

‘I came up to Abu Ja’farasws, so heasws said: ‘By Allahazwj, O Kumeyt, if weasws had in ourasws possession some wealth, weasws would have given you from it, but for you is what the Rasoolsaww Allahazwj said to Hassan Bin Sabit: ‘The Holy Spirit will not cease to be with you so long as you defend ussaww’.
I said, ‘Inform me about the two men (Abu Bakr and Umar)’.

He (the narrator) said: ‘He<sup>asws</sup> took the pillow and folded it unto his<sup>asws</sup> chest’ and said: ‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, O Kumeyt, there is no blood spilled unlawfully, nor any wealth taken without right, and not stone turned from another stone except that it would be upon their necks’.
en.sarwar: 75. And by this chain, from Abaan, from Uqba Bin Basheer Al-Asady, from Al-Kumeyt Bin Zayd Al-asady who said:

‘I came up to Abu Ja’far (a.s.), so he (a.s.) said: ‘By Allah (azwj), O Kumeyt, if we (a.s.) had in our (a.s.) possession some wealth, we (a.s.) would have given you from it, but for you is what the Rasool (saww) Allah (azwj) said to Hassan Bin Sabit: ‘The Holy Spirit will not cease to be with you so long as you defend us (saww)’.
I said, ‘Inform me about the two men (Abu Bakr and Umar)’.

He (the narrator) said: ‘He (a.s.) took the pillow and folded it unto his (a.s.) chest’ and said: ‘By Allah (azwj), O Kumeyt, there is no blood spilled unlawfully, nor any wealth taken without right, and not stone turned from another stone except that it would be upon their necks’.
